newsitem.title: USA: FiberChem cuts 1996 results after review.
newsitem.headline: FiberChem cuts 1996 results after review.

text.p: FiberChem Inc said Tuesday that after a review of its revenue recognition policy, it is revising downward its fiscal 1996 results and expects to report a loss of $3.3 million on revenues of $900,000.
Previously, for the first nine months of the fiscal year, the company reported a loss of $1.6 million on revenues of $1.8 million.
"Revenues for the first fiscal quarter of 1997, ended December 31, are similarly affected," FiberChem said. "They are anticipated to be substantially lower than previously expected."
It said it would restate fiscal 1996 third quarter earnings and possibly earnings for other quarters.
Revenues not recognized for the first quarter of fiscal 1997 should be recognized in subsequent periods, it said.
FiberChem said that historically it has recognized revenue when title passed -- normally upon shipment of product to a customer.
It said it had determined that recognition of revenue worth about $1.8 million, mostly from distributors, should be deferred to subsequent periods due to delays in acceptance of some of its products.

It said there had been a slowdown in installations and hence a slowdown in receipt of anticipated orders in the offshore oil production market. FiberChem makes fiber optic chemical sensors that detect pollutants.
FiberChem said its Audit Committee concluded that revenue adjustments were necessary but did not entail any improprieties by the company or its officers.
